chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Generosity (or discounting) is from the gains (profit). He said this to a man whom he was advising, and with him was a commodity he wanted to sell.'

key_terms.السَّمَاحَةُ: Generosity, leniency, or discounting in trade

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Samahah' mean in the context of Islamic trade ethics?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) conveys the Prophet’s advice to a merchant to practice 'samahah' (generosity or leniency in price), defining it as a source of 'ribah' (profit or gain). This narration underscores the Shia ethical framework where moral conduct in trade is not merely virtuous but intrinsically linked to economic prosperity and divine blessing.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Tolerance (discounting) is from the gains’. He<sup>saww</sup> said that to a man whom he<sup>saww</sup> advised and with him was a commodity he wanted to sell’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy, who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘Generosity is of profits.’ The Messenger of Allah said it to a man who had asked for good advice and who had certain merchandise that he wanted to sell.’”
